column1: # ci/extract-dlls.tsv - the files of the FL Studio installer (flstudio_win64_26.1.7.5653.exe) that the engine bundle build reads, besides the seed files of lift/harness/seeds/vfs-seed-idle1.tsv.

# Fields (TAB): name in the installer's NSIS file list (matched as a case-insensitive suffix, like tools/extract_nsis2.py) <TAB> destination under HOST_ROOT <TAB> SHA-256 the extracted bytes must have
# The SHA-256 values are the ones of docs/investigations/win64-extraction.md (FLEngine) and docs/investigations/bundled-dll-inventory.md (the others).
